notes: v324 — COUNTING FAMILY (owner's law restated Nov 5, 2026, after the sites swapped mid-day on his Aecon run and the count fell 5 -> 0 and climbed back): COUNT-BY-DUMP-VISIT + SITE-EXTENT + REPEG-RESETS-LOAD-COUNT. (1) A load now counts on each VISIT to the dump site — a new pure engine (createDumpVisitCounter) owns dispatch-pin days (lone load pin excluded — teach, below), dump-pin-only days, a lone dump peg, taught dumps, proven outer pattern pairs and navigated dumps: arrival at the site after having left counts; the visit closes at the load end, on a far exit, or at a tip-length foreign stop when no load end is known (that stop is then LEARNED as an other end). The pickup is bonus context only, never a required half of a cycle. (2) SITE-EXTENT: a peg/pin stands for the whole SITE, not a point — presence is 250 m around every learned face; moving inside the site at site speed to a new face kilometres away EXTENDS the site and never recounts the visit (one visit tips once); a tip-length road stop mid-visit becomes a standby point that counts only if a later visit ARRIVES there. A first dwell at a virgin face is a PENDING visit (the v220 law: a dwell is not proof) — it counts when the loop completes at the load end, at the stop's own time; tipping at a known face instead retires it as a scout. (3) REPEG: the armed branch's restore arithmetic is now key-gated (the Nov 5 bug: savedCount was subtracted without checking the sites key, so a mid-session role swap banked the old counter's loads AND started the new one at zero — the day read 0). A moved pin/peg banks the day's whole count and event trail in the base; the count belongs to the day. (4) A lone DUMP peg arms visit counting on its own (Nov 5: dump pegged 9:40, pickup 11:40 — the morning can now count); a lone pickup peg with no dispatch teaches as a load pin does. Scope notes (owner's other laws stand): a BOTH-PEGS day keeps the peg cycle counter — its v282/v284 contract (seeds-not-fences centres, pegEvents trail, same-site sub-spots) is untouched, and its banking already satisfies REPEG. Dump-pin-only days also seed the pattern learner on the pin, so a same-place job's proven pair can still take over (presence geometry cannot separate sub-spots).
